_comment: windows.c adjust_menu_promptstyle() hands iflags.menu_headings, color and attribute, to wintty.c tty_end_menu(), which draws every menu prompt in that style; o_init.c dodiscovered() instead putstr()s its class headings in a text window with menu_headings.attr only, so they carry no color. An elven Wizard with menu_headings:green&inverse opens the wizard-mode level-teleport menu (dungeon.c print_dungeon(), whose prompt is green and inverse), cancels, then lists her discoveries (inverse, uncolored headings). Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
